articles.title: Twin Cities Tech Conference Returns
articles.summary: Annual tech conference returns to Minneapolis with 50+ speakers covering AI, startup funding, and emerging technologies. Registration opens this Friday.

articles.title: Maplewood Park Renovation Complete
articles.summary: Renovations to Maplewood Park finished ahead of schedule, adding new walking trails and a children's playground. Grand reopening is Saturday.

articles.title: State Fair Attendance Drops Slightly
articles.summary: Minnesota State Fair saw a 3% decline in attendance this year, with cooler-than-average weather cited as a factor.
